caption: The drawing depicts a single white ceramic mug with a handle on the right side. The mug has a round base and a slightly flared rim. On the side of the mug, there is a small decorative element featuring a pinkish-red rose with subtle shading. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. There are two small, faint yellowish spots near the mug on the left side of the composition. The drawing is centered on the page, with ample empty space around the mug. In the bottom left corner, a signature in cursive handwriting is visible, reading “Roberta Joel Spicer.”
title: Mug
